maxBedTemperature.reason: Inherited generic ABS uses 105C; K1C hardware specification is 100C. Adapter caps inherited defaults at 100C.

singleMaterial.reason: This application exposes one material and one extruder.

elegooRapidPetg.reason: Adapted starting preset for K1C, not a measured calibration for a particular spool. Retains upstream 250C nozzle, 18 mm3/s volumetric cap, 0.99 flow ratio and 30-80% part cooling. K1C machine and process settings remain unchanged.

bedTemperature.reason: Supported build plates use 80C, within the current Elegoo recommendation of 75-90C, instead of the inherited Orca library default of 70C.

nozzleTemperatureRange.reason: Recommended range metadata follows current Elegoo specification; 250C print temperature follows upstream Rapid PETG preset.

pressureAdvance.reason: Do not apply the cross-printer system preset pressure advance of 0.052 to this K1C. Leave existing firmware calibration in effect.

preferredProcess.reason: User-requested defaults. Inner/Outer/Inner needs at least three walls. 100% infill uses rectilinear. Lower inherited role/first-layer accelerations are retained; higher role defaults are capped at 5000 mm/s².

kampStartup.requires: Guilouz Creality Helper Script KAMP installed on the printer; user confirmed it is installed.
kampStartup.reason: Enable adaptive mesh and purge with helper mode macros, then call START_PRINT once. START_PRINT owns homing, meshing and purge. Exclude-object polygons carry actual object boundaries; no second mesh or purge is added.
